title: dedup keyed on body Message-ID not envelope msgid (closes bypass attack)
description:
## Decision
crates/transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs check_ingest() deduplicates on the body Message-ID header value, not on the IHAVE/TAKETHIS envelope msgid. This closes a well-known Usenet bypass: a peer could send IHAVE <fresh-envelope> carrying a body with Message-ID: <known-dup> and the envelope-keyed dedup would miss it. The fix is correct, well-commented, and has a regression test (dedup_keyed_on_body_msgid_not_envelope).
